editorial:
Imagine being a top-tier bodyguard who is supposed to protect the most powerful man in the world, but instead, you get stuck babysitting a First Lady who absolutely cannot stand you. That is the deal Jay Killon walks into. You get a great mix of tension and bickering as Lara Royce tries every trick in the book to shake him off. It feels like a classic 80s cat-and-mouse game where the two main characters spend half their time fighting each other and the other half running for their lives. The vibe is punchy and keeps you guessing whether the real danger is the people chasing them or their own clashing personalities.

What really works here is the chemistry between the leads and the steady build-up of the mystery. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the action sequences are solid for the era. If you love old-school thrillers with a touch of romance and a lot of chasing, you will have a blast. You should definitely try to track down the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, but renting it on Apple TV is a great way to check it out first. It is a perfect weekend movie for when you just want some easy, exciting entertainment.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the true identity of the assassin is revealed. After a wild chase and several close calls, Killon manages to outsmart the killers and save Lara. The twist shows that the conspiracy went deeper into the government than they first thought. Once the bad guys are defeated, Lara finally gains a huge amount of respect for Killon, and they end the movie with a much softer, friendlier relationship.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic bodyguard movies and romantic tension.
